story.titleZh: 2026年荷兰大奖赛排位赛赢家与输家点评
story.summaryZh: The 比赛团队点评了赞德福特赛道竞争激烈的2026年荷兰大奖赛排位赛，列出表现突出与令人失望的车手，其中阿斯顿·马丁车队两位车手仅列第18和第19位。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from 2026 Dutch GP qualifying
story.summaryEn: The Race team reviewed the highly competitive qualifying session for the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, highlighting both standout performers and disappointments, with Aston Martin's drivers qualifying only 18th and 19th.
detailZh: 我们评选出了在赞德沃特举行的竞争激烈、差距微小的2026年荷兰大奖赛一级方程式排位赛中的赢家和输家。
输家：阿斯顿·马丁本田车队（第18名和第19名）
相比冲刺排位赛确实有进步，但排位赛结束后，最能说明问题的还是兰斯·斯特罗尔对本田进步幅度的评价。
他称这只是一次“小步前进”，并表示“远远不够”。
此外，它还带来了不理想的驾驶性问题，这些问题最早在亨格罗林拍摄日的首秀上就被发现。这意味着车手们在入弯时无法确定自己会有多少动力，也不知道会不会像阿隆索在周五的排位赛第一阶段（SQ1）中那样被直接甩出赛道。
“这就像抽彩票。现在我们就是得不到一致性的发动机制动，入弯时还出现很多被拒绝的降挡。所以，是的，问题很多。”斯特罗尔这样总结道。
这些驾驶性问题需要回到位于日本樱市的本田总部去解决，而不是在赛道边。因此，指望在蒙扎之前有所改善是不现实的——而到了蒙扎，问题可能会更加严重。
两位车手都对阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利站底盘方面取得的进步赞不绝口，但据车手们说，目前第二版本田引擎还没能跟上这个进步。——乔什·萨蒂尔
卫冕冠军拿下了连续第二个杆位，也是2026赛季第二个非梅赛德斯车队的杆位——周六下午在赞德福特，他挡住了两位梅赛德斯车手。
当Q3尾声下起雨时，诺里斯挡住了乔治·拉塞尔，当时这位梅赛德斯车手在他后视镜中逼近，试图完成超越以获得干净空气。在Q3中保持在梅赛德斯之前的位置，对诺里斯的杆位单圈起到了关键作用。
“没有比这更好的了，说实话有点惊讶。一圈不错的成绩，我全力推进了，你们也看到了差距有多小，每一百分之一秒都可能决定胜负，”他说。“相比之前我们感觉有点挣扎的表现，这是一个不错的转变。”
鉴于自2021年赞德福特回归赛历以来，荷兰大奖赛的冠军均由杆位发车者获得，这一转变可能至关重要。——萨马特·卡纳尔
在赞德沃特的五个排位赛阶段中，利亚姆·劳森平均比马克斯·维斯塔潘慢0.128秒。这可是马克斯·维斯塔潘啊！如果你是劳森或者他的粉丝，这个成绩基本上值得开个派对庆祝一下。
在其中两个阶段，他击败了维斯塔潘，而在最后一个计入成绩的阶段，他只慢了0.115秒。
维斯塔潘几乎是不可能击败的。这辆红牛赛车非常难以驾驭。但尽管如此，劳森在缺乏准备的情况下顶替伊萨克·哈贾尔出场，仍然找到了证明自己实力的方式。
考虑到他第一次效力红牛车队时的糟糕表现，你就能理解为什么没人把他和正式回归厂队联系在一起。但抛开这一点不谈，他在这种情况下已经做到了车手所能期望的最好水平。——杰克·贝尼翁
法拉利的排位赛魔咒仍在继续，这支车队就是没能在周六找到状态。
汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在排位赛速度上的竞争力非常强，周六下午两人的差距仅有0.064秒——而在此前周五的冲刺排位赛中，两人相差接近六分之一秒（0.6秒）。但这已经是法拉利能拿到的最好的消息了。
勒克莱尔解释说，法拉利在从第二节排位赛（Q2）到第三节排位赛（Q3）更换模式时“出现了错误，也就是动力模式的切换”。
“这让我对赛车的手感受到了一些影响，我们需要研究一下，”他说。“但我认为无论如何，本来也不具备争夺杆位的潜力。”
汉密尔顿将排位赛的不佳表现归咎于轮胎升温不足，但他希望法拉利强劲的正赛节奏能带来一些安慰。
只要起步顺利，车队（Scuderia，即法拉利）至少能在周九跟住领先集团的尾部——不过考虑到赞德沃特很难超车，登上领奖台可能有些勉强。 - SK
周五冲刺赛排位赛中，皮埃尔·加斯利的升级版阿尔派领跑中游车队引发了大量热议，但一天后的正式排位赛上，加斯利却一头雾水，止步于第二节排位赛（Q2）。
“如果那已经是绝对最佳的一圈、一切感觉都很棒、而我们只差0.1秒，那才会更令人担忧。我只是觉得目前一切还没有完全协调好。”这是加斯利对当前局面的乐观解读。
显然这些升级是一个进步，但阿尔派还没有完全弄清楚如何将它们的潜力发挥到极致。这很令人恼火，因为冲刺赛已经表明排位赛在这里有多重要，而且考虑到超车难度，明天的正赛将会很艰难，至少想追平加斯利在冲刺赛中的第八名并不容易。
但最终他说得对，这里没有必要恐慌。这只不过是因为升级套件很早就在一辆车上率先引入，车手们对其缺乏经验而已。——简森·巴顿
周四在非常严厉地批评了哈斯赛车的发展之后，奥利·比尔曼又在赞德沃特连续两次于一阶段排位（Q1）中出局，都排在了队友身后，周六更是拿到第二十位，这是他本赛季至今最差的成绩。
“冲刺赛之后我们做了一些小的调整，但说实话，我们其实能做的并不多，”比尔曼说。
“我们最后总是只能跑同样的配置，因为这是我们唯一能从赛车上榨出一点残余性能的办法，是的，这根本不管用。”
埃斯特班·奥康指出了本周末影响贝尔曼的零件一致性问题，这意味着“每次你把车放下，就像抛硬币，一辆车能用，另一辆车不能用”。
第一节排位赛中，博托莱托在一号弯出弯时发生了一次严重打滑，差点提前结束他的排位赛——但他不仅稳住了，随后还表现出色。
“我不知道自己在干什么，”他在压到太多路缘石后不得不重新稳住时，在无线电里大声喊道。
这位巴西车手在第一节排位赛（Q1）中恢复状态拿到第10名，随后在第二节排位赛（Q2）中比队友尼克·霍肯伯格快了0.3秒。
他承认那是一个“可怕的时刻”——而且在接下来的阶段他差点再次遭遇——他把第一节排位赛的失误归因于赞德福特赛道周围的阵风。
这位奥迪车队的车手的排位成绩还超过了小红牛的阿尔维德·林德布拉德（第10名）以及驾驶升级版赛车的加斯利（第11名）。
在冲刺赛中与积分失之交臂后，博尔托莱托现在有机会在四个周末中第三次拿到积分。——天空体育
detailEn: Our picks for the winners and losers from a highly competitive and close F1 qualifying session for the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort.
Loser: Aston Martin Honda (18th and 19th)
Progress from sprint qualifying, no doubt, but it was Lance Stroll’s verdict on Honda’s step forward that was most telling after qualifying.
He called it a “small step” and said it’s “not nearly enough”.

Plus, it’s also created unwanted driveability issues that were first flagged in the Hungaroring filming day debut. It means the drivers are heading into corner entries uncertain of how much power they’ll have, and whether they’ll be fired off the road like Fernando Alonso was in SQ1 on Friday.
“It's a lottery. Right now we're just not getting the consistent engine braking, going into the corner and a lot of rejected downshifts. So, yeah, a lot of issues,” was Stroll’s summary.
Those driveability issues need to be solved back at Honda HQ in Sakura, Japan, rather than trackside. So it’s unrealistic to expect improvements until Monza - where it could be even more punishing.
Both drivers were effusive about the step with the chassis Aston Martin made in Hungary, but right now, according to the drivers, the spec 2 Honda hasn’t matched that. - Josh Suttill
The reigning champion took his second-straight pole position and the second non-Mercedes pole position of 2026 - holding off both Mercedes drivers on Saturday afternoon in Zandvoort.

As the rain fell at the end of Q3, Norris held George Russell off as the Mercedes driver loomed in his wing mirrors, looking to overtake and gain clean air. That spot ahead of the Mercedes in Q3 proved pivotal to Norris’s pole lap.

“It doesn't get any better, a little surprised honestly. A decent lap, I was pushing as you've seen how close it is, every one-hundredth can make a difference,” he said. “A good turnaround from earlier where I felt we struggled a little bit."
This turnaround could prove crucial given that since Zandvoort returned in 2021, the Dutch Grand Prix has been won from pole position. - Samarth Kanal

Over five qualifying segments, Liam Lawson was an average of 0.128s off Max Verstappen at Zandvoort. Max Verstappen! It’s a result basically worth throwing a party for if you’re Lawson or one of his fans.
In two of those segments he beat Verstappen, and in the final one that counted, he was 0.115s off.
Verstappen’s almost impossible to beat. This Red Bull is so tough to drive. But still, Lawson has found a way to be relevant despite his lack of preparation stepping in for Isack Hadjar.

After how badly his first Red Bull stint went, you can understand why nobody is linking him with a permanent return to the works team. But that aside, he’s done about as well as you’d expect any driver to in these circumstances. - Jack Benyon
Ferrari’s qualifying hoodoo continues as the team just can’t get it going on Saturdays.

Hamilton and Leclerc are incredibly competitive on qualifying pace and were split by just 0.064s on Saturday afternoon - having been almost six-tenths apart in Friday’s sprint qualifying. But that’s really as positive as it gets.
Leclerc explained that Ferrari made “mistakes in changing modes, power modes from Q2 to Q3.
“That put me off a little bit with the feeling I had with the car and we'll have to look into it," he said. "But I don't think the potential for pole position was there anyway.”
Hamilton pointed towards poor tyre warm-up for his qualifying woes, but hopes Ferrari’s strong race pace can provide the consolation.
With a solid start, the Scuderia could at least stay on the tail of the leading pack on Sunday - although the podium might be a stretch given how hard it is to overtake at Zandvoort. - SK

There was a lot of hype about the upgraded Alpine of Pierre Gasly leading the midfield in sprint qualifying on Friday, but fast-forward to qualifying proper a day later and Gasly was left perplexed and out in Q2.

“If it was the absolute best lap and everything felt amazing and we're a tenth off, then it would be more concerning. I just think things didn't quite click yet,” was Gasly’s glass-half-full take on the situation.

Clearly the upgrades are a step forward, but Alpine hasn’t worked out exactly how to get the best out of them. That’s annoying as the sprint race showed how important qualifying is here, and the race will be tough tomorrow in terms of overtaking, at least to match Gasly’s P8 from the sprint race.
But he’s right ultimately that there’s no need to panic here. It’s just a case of inexperience with an upgrade package introduced early on one car only. - JB

After being very critical of Haas’s car development on Thursday, Ollie Bearman followed that up with two Q1 exits behind his team-mate at Zandvoort, bagging 20th on Saturday, which was his worst result of the season so far.
“We did a few small changes [after the sprint], but there's not really much that we can do, to be honest with you,” Bearman said.
“We always end up running the same configuration, because it's the only way we can get any remnants of performance out of the car, and yeah, it's just not worked.”
Esteban Ocon pointed to the parts inconsistency issues affecting Bearman this weekend, which means "Every time you put a car down, you flip a coin and one car will work, one car will not".
A huge slide at the exit of Turn 1 in Q1 nearly ended Bortoleto’s qualifying session early - yet he recovered, and then some.
“I don’t know what I’m doing,” he exclaimed on the radio after he took too much of the kerbs and had to reset.
The Brazilian driver recovered to 10th in Q1 and then went three-tenths faster than team-mate Nico Hulkenberg in Q2.
He conceded it was a “scary moment” - and he almost repeated it in the following sessions - attributing his Q1 moment to the gusts around Zandvoort.
The Audi driver also outqualified Racing Bulls’s Arvid Lindblad (P10) and the upgraded Alpine of Gasly (P11).
Having missed out on a point in the sprint, Bortoleto now has a chance to score points for the third time in four weekends. - SK

relatedItems.titleZh: 2026年卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛结果
relatedItems.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)
17 塞恩斯 (威廉姆斯) 1m24.370s +0.096s (与Q2差距)
19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.
Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:
11 Ollie Bearman (Haas) 1m23.367s +0.240s (gap to Q3)
17 Carlos Sainz (Williams) 1m24.370s +0.096s (gap to Q2)
19 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +0.436s

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
